scope: Docker inside the dedicated Lima zapret vzNAT VM; IPv4. No zapret execution on macOS, directly in the VM, or on the OpenWrt router. No authenticated Discord session.
native_manager_integration: Passed inside Docker: sky installation/start, cancellation, list-preserving reinstall, flat/sky switching, native YouTube/Discord/Anime365 body completion, persistent command registration, invalid-profile rollback, and uninstall.
change: Move Discord's existing hostlist into a first-match TLS profile with tcp_ack=1000 instead of tcp_ts=-1000. Preserve Google-SNI fake, six repeats, multidisorder split points, media TCP ports, all other service profiles, and UDP handling.

reproduction.condition: Original sky with net.ipv4.tcp_timestamps=0 in the Docker test namespace

candidate_selection.tcp_ack_1_and_1000: Both completed Discord homepage, gateway JSON, CDN avatar and unrelated control with TCP timestamps enabled and disabled. Selected 1000.
rejected: ALT4-like tcp_seq=1000:tcp_ack=-66000:tcp_ts_up plus multisplit timed out on this Docker path; not deployed.
Negative TCP sequence offsets and negative ACK offsets timed out; not deployed.
TTL 2, ACK +1000000, unset ACK and set SYN allowed small replies but stalled the Discord homepage at 9565 bytes; not accepted as working.
TTL 3/4 and TCP MD5 timed out; badsum caused TLS failure; positive sequence alone caused resets. Not deployed.
candidate_selection.limit: These observations do not identify which hop filters or normalizes packets, and are not universal judgments about those techniques.

fixed_timestamp_less_checks.regression_command: Run tools/test-sky-discord.py under /sky/run.sh in Docker as documented in README.md
fixed_timestamp_less_checks.gateway_websocket: Verified upgrade acceptance hash, complete text Hello with op=10 and positive heartbeat_interval

updater_module.expected_hash_source: Existing discord-updater-verified.jsonl; complete body matches the previously recorded manifest hash, not an updater application execution

fixed_timestamp_less_checks.media_tls: discord.media ports 443,2053,2083,2087,2096,8443 all completed TLS 1.3 with certificate verification
fixed_timestamp_less_checks.media_http_limit: The apex is not a live voice endpoint: HTTP on 443 returned 520; the five alternate ports timed out waiting for an HTTP response. Separate TLS-only checks passed; do not report the HTTP origin as working.
fixed_timestamp_less_checks.udp_loopback: Discovery and STUN each delivered six exact Steam fake blobs plus one unchanged original; unrelated UDP delivered only its original. A following audio-like RTP payload on each flow was unchanged and generated no extra fake.

limits: No live voice, foreign-region channel, screenshare, authenticated startup, or router forwarding validation.
Other sky TLS service profiles still require negotiated TCP timestamps; their strategies were not changed.
No blanket IP/game catch-all rules, IPv6 changes, DNS changes, or new dependencies.
A successful local test cannot guarantee every ISP, TCP implementation, or future Discord endpoint.
